steps.detail: the registered migration set applied to a fresh cluster
one business, one provider account, one binding
1 campaign run(s) carry 2 distinct capture cohorts across 4 receipts

2 of 2 APPLICABLE budget owners carry a complete, valid, action-bearing retained fact (retained population 4); universe: applicable 2, proven non-owner 2, owner uncaptured 0, applicable owner missing 0, hierarchy contradictions 0, conflicts 0; complete-run attestation present.

cases.name: real_capture_path_ready
cases.mechanics: two syncs of identical mapped campaign/ad-set responses through mapCampaignObservationState + mapAdSetObservationState + persistMetaEntityObservation; second sync coalesced onto the same run and appended a second receipt under a different partition; no D086 fixture rows

cases.name: newer_failed_blocks_older_complete
cases.mechanics: one complete capture at 09:06, then a FAILED capture at 11:06 on the same endpoint; the older complete run is still present and readable

cases.name: newer_partial_blocks_older_complete
cases.mechanics: one complete capture at 09:06, then a PARTIAL capture at 11:06

cases.name: wrong_endpoint_named
cases.mechanics: the campaign capture recorded endpoint ad_configs; the receipt and the run both carry it, so nothing is filtered away and the cause is visible

cases.name: cohort_mismatch_across_syncs
cases.mechanics: campaign and ad-set receipts carry different partition ids at the same clock

cases.name: explicit_tombstone_supersedes_manifest
cases.mechanics: persistMetaExplicitEntityTombstone wrote 1 row into meta_entity_tombstones after the manifest's own capture clock

cases.name: delta_manifest_reconstructed
cases.mechanics: the campaign run is manifest_kind='delta'; membership is rebuilt from the latest complete-lane present rows at or before its payload clock

cases.name: tied_receipts_forward_insertion
cases.mechanics: two campaign receipts inserted in forward physical order, partitions 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999910 then 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999911

cases.name: tied_receipts_reversed_insertion
cases.mechanics: two campaign receipts inserted in reversed physical order, partitions 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999911 then 99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999910

indexCatalog.indexdef: CREATE INDEX idx_meta_entity_observation_receipts_freshness ON public.meta_entity_observation_receipts USING btree (business_id, provider_account_id, entity_type, endpoint, captured_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meta_entity_observation_receipts_occurrence ON public.meta_entity_observation_receipts USING btree (partition_id, entity_type, endpoint, captured_at)

CREATE INDEX idx_meta_entity_observation_receipts_cohort ON public.meta_entity_observation_receipts USING btree (business_id, provider_account_id, partition_id, entity_type, endpoint, captured_at DESC, id DESC)

CREATE INDEX idx_meta_entity_observation_runs_d086_effective ON public.meta_entity_observation_runs USING btree (business_id, provider_account_id, entity_type, endpoint, COALESCE(last_captured_at, captured_at) DESC, LEAST(COALESCE(last_seen_at, observed_at), COALESCE(last_captured_at, captured_at)) DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_meta_entity_tombstones_d086_latest ON public.meta_entity_tombstones USING btree (business_id, provider_account_id, entity_type, entity_id, captured_at DESC, id DESC)
